svg.title: The wiki's three layers, with operations
svg.desc: Architecture diagram. Central three-layer wiki stack: L3 Schema (CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, frontmatter spec; human-authored, read before every action), L2 Wiki pages (coral focal; LLM-written markdown, wikilinks, compiled; ~10-15 pages edited per ingest), L1 Raw sources (PDFs, transcripts, clips; content-hashed, immutable). Four operations orbit the stack: Source drop on the left feeds L1 (labeled DROP), Ingest on top writes L2 (WRITES), Query on the right reads L2 (READS) with a dashed return arrow APPENDS, Lint at the bottom audits L2 (AUDITS).
svg.text: PDF · transcript · clip · lands in L1
reads L1 + L3 · writes L2 · ~10–15 pages edited
reads L2 + L3 · answer may become a page
periodic · scans L2 · flags violations at commit
L2 is the compiled artefact. Every operation on
the wiki either writes it, reads it, or audits it.
Compile at ingest, read many times at query.
Lint keeps L2 honest; L1 and L3 stay stable.
